snippet.title: GREEN SCREEN ANIMATION
snippet.description:
Green Screen Animation - it's the largest source of green screen effects stock footage! We include green-screen effects, transition, overlays, animation, titles, and motion backgrounds. And all this and much more for free!

Subscribe and improve your own video in an easy way!

You can: 
- Use & edit our footage in all kinds of projects.
- YouTube monetization allowed ( link to our channel in the description )
- For a film or TV use request a license: grscanimation@gmail.com

How to use our channel?:
How to get GS Footage Tutorial - https://youtu.be/4tfEJFqU4tg
How to use GS Footage - https://goo.gl/MTqUhT

What video editing software do I need? 
One of these lists: After Effects, Final Cut , Sony Vegas , Premier Pro , HitFilm , iMovie , Corel Video Studio and similar. 

We will upload a new video every day! 
NOTE: Not copy or re-upload organic videos, please! 

You can hire me for your video editing projects etc.
Hope you like our channel! Consider Subscribing!
